verdict.rationale: Google ADK is a framework for building agents. A framework could plausibly offer built-in AI insights (for example, on agent traces or evaluation results), so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only developer building blocks: models, tools, workflows and a dev UI for testing and debugging. Nothing documents a built-in feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
